notes.title: Be The First To Enter The Void!
notes.content:
🚀 The Alpha is Almost Here!
We’ll be inviting players to the upcoming playtest very soon, and everyone on our mailing list will get first access. Don’t miss out, be among the first to jump in and help shape the game!


Sign up here!


What is the Alpha?
The Alpha is a small peek at what we’ve been building—a limited version of the game designed to gather your feedback and refine the experience.

This is just the first step! A larger, more in-depth open demo will follow once we’ve incorporated what we learn from this early playtest.
